description: Source code for managing opaque objects in PyTorch, including registration, type checking, and representation of custom user-defined opaque types for use in Torch's compilation and tracing system.

classes.name: FakeOpaqueObject
classes.description: A fake class representing an opaque object, registered with a special identifier for use in PyTorch's internal systems.

classes.name: _OpaqueTypeInfo
classes.description: Data class storing information about an opaque type, including class name, type (value or reference), guard function, and members handling.

classes.name: MemberType
classes.description: Enum defining how members of opaque objects are handled during tracing: either 'use_real' or 'inlined'.

methods.name: get_opaque_type_name
methods.description: Retrieves the registered opaque type name for a given class.

methods.name: register_opaque_type
methods.description: Registers a class as an opaque type (value or reference) with optional guard function and member handling.

methods.name: is_opaque_value
methods.description: Checks if a given object is an opaque value type.

methods.name: is_opaque_type
methods.description: Checks if a class or string name is registered as an opaque type.

methods.name: is_opaque_value_type
methods.description: Checks if a class or name corresponds to an opaque value type.

methods.name: is_opaque_reference_type
methods.description: Checks if a class or name corresponds to an opaque reference type.

methods.name: get_opaque_obj_repr
methods.description: Returns an evaluable string representation and globals dict for reconstructing an opaque object.

methods.name: get_opaque_obj_info
methods.description: Retrieves stored information about an opaque type given a class or name.

methods.name: get_member_type
methods.description: Gets the handling type for a specific member of an opaque object class.
